We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

**The opportunity

**At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

**We Are Proud Of

**

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

**The Role

**Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

**Role Responsibilities

**

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

**What We Expect Of You

**

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

**Must Have Qualifications

**

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

**We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

**The Benefits

**This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer

**

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

**Your application process

**Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

**About Valtech

**Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Application deadline: December 18 , 2026

Please send your application as soon as possible - we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English. To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Rasmus Jørgensen (Manager, Cloud Platforms) at rasmusbo.jorgensen@egmont.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Workplace Manager for Facility Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by creating exceptional workplace experiences and thrive on building strong stakeholder relationships while driving operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented Workplace Manager to join our Facility Management team.

At NNE, we believe that great workplaces create great employee experiences. Our Facility Management team plays a key role in ensuring that our offices are safe, efficient, welcoming, and aligned with the needs of a growing organisation.

As Workplace Manager, you will take ownership of workplace and facility operations at our headquarters in Virum while helping shape the future workplace experience through continuous improvements, digital solutions, and close collaboration with stakeholders across the business.

You will act as the local face of Facility Management and become a trusted partner to employees, managers, landlords, and service providers. Through your visible presence, strong relationships, and proactive approach, you will help create a workplace where people can thrive and perform at their best.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining operational excellence with stakeholder engagement, workplace experience, and modern ways of working.

How you might spend your days

As a Workplace Manager you’ll be:

• Acting as the visible and approachable local FM representative, building strong relationships across the organisation.

• Coordinating day-to-day facility operations to ensure a safe, efficient and well-functioning workplace.

• Managing relationships with landlords, vendors, contractors and service providers to ensure high-quality services and agreed service levels.

• Driving maintenance activities, space planning, workplace services and facility related projects.

• Using workplace data, Power BI insights, digital tools, and emerging technologies to optimize workplace services, support decision-making and enhance the employee experience.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Being outgoing and comfortable meeting stakeholders across the business, building relationships and ensuring a visible and approachable FM presence.

• A proactive and positive team player who takes ownership and drives tasks forward.

• Thriving in a service-oriented environment and motivated by creating value for colleagues and stakeholders.

• Building trust through great stakeholder management skills and communicate effectively across all organizational levels.

• Enjoying collaborating with others, fostering positive relationships, and achieving results as part of a team.

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• 
Experience within Workplace Management, Facility Management, Property Management, or a similar operational role.

• 
Relevant educational background within Facility Management, Building Construction, Architectural Technology, Construction Management or related discipline.

• 
Experience coordinating vendors, maintenance activities and facility-related projects.

• 
Experience working with budgets, invoice management and service contracts.

• 
Strong digital mindset with an interest in workplace technology, automation and data-driven decision-making.

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 6th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Associate Manager, Martin Dang at +45 3191 1695.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Job Description:

****Performance Manager, Global Regulatory Affairs, 1-year contract

****Would you like to help shape how we understand and improve Regulatory performance across our global organisation?

**We are looking for a Global Regulatory Performance Manager to join us at the Ferring International PharmaScience Center in Kastrup, Copenhagen for a 12-month period. Here, you’ll become part of the Global Regulatory Affairs function and help establish a transparent, meaningful and sustainable approach to measuring regulatory performance.

**Ferring + you

**You will join the Global Regulatory Labelling and Performance team, where global labelling process ownership and regulatory operational support come together to strengthen performance across Global Regulatory Affairs. Working across functions and geographies, the team connects processes, embeds quality and compliance, and drives continuous improvement and more consistent ways of working.

In this newly created, project-oriented role, you will have the opportunity to shape how regulatory performance is measured and understood globally. Bringing together people, processes, and data, you will lead the development and implementation of a global Regulatory KPI framework and turn performance data into actionable insights that enable stronger decision-making, greater transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Your day at Ferring

**As Global Regulatory Performance Manager, you will work across Global Regulatory Affairs, collaborating with colleagues globally to define what good regulatory performance looks like and how it should be measured. You will play a key role in creating greater transparency around performance and turning data into insights that support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead the development and implementation of a global Regulatory Performance, Governance and KPI framework.

• Drive cross-functional alignment on meaningful KPIs, including definitions, data sources, ownership and reporting requirements.

• Lead the development and continuous improvement of Regulatory performance dashboards and reporting.

• Enable consistent and transparent monitoring of performance across geographies.

• Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights, identifying trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.

• Partner with Regulatory process owners and key stakeholders to identify and drive performance and process improvements.

• Lead cross-functional performance initiatives from definition through implementation.

• Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

Your work will help Global Regulatory Affairs move from individual performance measures towards a more connected and transparent view of Regulatory performance. By establishing meaningful KPIs and effective performance monitoring, you will enable the organization to identify trends, focus attention where it matters most, and make better -informed decisions that drive continuous improvement.

**Behind our innovation – there’s you

**In our team, we are committed to helping each other succeed. Thus we are looking for a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and turning ideas, data and processes into tangible outcomes. You thrive in a cross-functional environment, are confident bringing different stakeholders together, and are curious enough to challenge whether we are measuring what truly matters.

We imagine that you bring:

• Strong experience in project management and/or performance management, ideally from the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated environment.

• Proven experience developing KPIs, performance frameworks, dashboards and management reporting.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, meaningful and actionable business insights.

• Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive progress across functions and organizational levels.

• Experience with data visualization and reporting tools, such as Power BI.

• An understanding of Regulatory Affairs or pharmaceutical business processes would be an advantage.

• A pragmatic and collaborative mindset, with a strong focus on implementation, continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.

• A master’s degree or equivalent experience in Life Sciences, Business, Engineering, Data/Business Analytics, or another relevant discipline.

Above all, you are someone who enjoys connecting people, processes and data, and who can move comfortably between strategic discussions and hands-on implementation.

We offer an inclusive and flexible working environment, with the opportunity to work remotely one day per week and on-site the remaining four days.

**Behind our purpose – there’s you

**If our mission and your vision are aligned, please apply. Kindly include a few lines regarding your motivation for applying in the CV or a cover letter. Please note that we review applications continuously and close the process when we find the right match.

We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this position. Candidates must be located in the Oresund region or willing to relocate at their own expense.

**__At Ferring Pharmaceuticals, we help people around the world build families and live better lives. We are entrepreneurial and innovative, with a global team focused on scientific advances in the areas of reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology and urology. _Do you want to shape the future of analytics for the world's largest jewellery brand? Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

• Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

• Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

• Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Forecasting & performance management

• Own forecasting and performance measurement that support commercial planning and trading decisions.

• Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

• Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

• Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

• Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

• Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.

• Ensure stakeholders can rely on trusted, decision-ready data.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing analytics team.

• Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

• Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

**We imagine that you bring significant experience within eCommerce analytics, commercial analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, combined with a passion for translating data into business value and strategic impact.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

**We Hope To See That You Are

**

• A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• An inspiring people leader and coach.

• A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

Do you enjoy making complex equipment run reliably, turning data into better decisions, and finding smarter ways to work?

At AGC Biologics in Søborg, we are looking for an Equipment Engineer to join our Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team. This is an opportunity to take ownership of maintenance and calibration planning while driving digitalization and continuous improvement across our pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

You will play an important role in ensuring our equipment is reliable, compliant, and ready to support production. Combining technical understanding, structured planning, data analysis, and digital tools, you will help move our maintenance organization towards a more proactive and data-driven approach.

And you won't be doing it alone. You will join a collaborative team of 23 technicians, engineers, and coordinators, working closely with Production, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and external suppliers.

**Your Role And Responsibilities

**You will have a varied role combining operational planning, technical problem-solving, and improvement projects.

**Maintenance & Calibration Planning

**

• Plan and coordinate maintenance and calibration activities to ensure timely execution and minimal production disruption.

• Maintain schedules, work orders, and equipment records in our CMMS.

• Monitor compliance, follow up on overdue activities, and coordinate resources during planned shutdowns.

• Use equipment history and performance data to optimize maintenance strategies and calibration intervals.

**Digitalization & Data Analysis

**

• Develop Power BI dashboards to monitor maintenance KPIs, equipment performance, downtime, and calibration compliance.

• Analyze data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.

• Drive digital solutions and automation using tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate.

**Equipment Reliability & GMP

**

• Lead or contribute to initiatives that improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

• Support troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

• Support audits, Change Requests, deviations, and CAPA activities.

• Ensure maintenance and calibration activities meet GMP requirements and continuously improve our procedures and documentation.

**What You Bring

**We are looking for a technically curious and structured engineer who enjoys taking ownership, working with data, and challenging existing ways of doing things.

**You Ideally Have

**

• A relevant technical education, such as Mechanical Engineer, Marine Engineer (Maskinmester), Production Engineer, or similar.

• 3–5 years of experience within maintenance engineering, maintenance planning, calibration, or a related technical field.

• Experience coordinating maintenance activities in an industrial or process environment.

• Familiarity with CMMS systems and maintenance documentation.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• An interest in digitalization and data-driven improvements.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Also Have

**

• Experience with calibration planning and maintenance strategies.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or SQL.

• Knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, or advanced Excel.

• Experience from a GMP-regulated environment such as pharma, biotech, or food production.

• Familiarity with Change Control, deviations, CAPA, FMEA, or reliability methodologies.

Pharmaceutical experience is an advantage, not a requirement. We are equally interested in candidates from other technical industries who bring relevant experience, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**Why join AGC Biologics?

**At AGC Biologics, your work contributes to something bigger. We partner with pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world to manufacture life-changing biopharmaceuticals that help patients.

**In This Role, You Will Get

**

• Real ownership: Take responsibility for maintenance and calibration planning and influence how we work.

• Room to innovate: Drive digitalization, automation, and data-driven improvements.

• Technical challenges: Work with complex manufacturing equipment in a highly specialized industry.

• Great colleagues: Join an experienced team with a collaborative mindset and a flat structure.

• Meaningful impact: Help ensure reliable production of therapies that make a difference to patients worldwide.

**Want to join the team?

**We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, and no later than Monday, November 23.

Make sure to attach an updated CV

You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you have the right technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and an interest in improving how things work, we would like to hear from you.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you want to help develop novel instrumentation for groundwater investigations? At the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aarhus University, we are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to contribute to the development of novel nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) instruments for groundwater characterization. You will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning electrical engineering, geophysics, and environmental science working on technologies that can improve our understanding of vital groundwater resources. The 2-year position is based in Aarhus, Denmark and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a 2–year position from 1 March 2027 or as soon possible thereafter.

Job description
We are seeking a postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to help develop a new generation of surface NMR instruments for groundwater characterization. Through a recently funded research project, we are building a new instrument with capabilities beyond those of existing systems. As part of the project, you will play a central role in designing and integrating key electronic subsystems and in exploring how the resulting instrument can open new possibilities for groundwater investigations.

Your tasks will include

• Design, simulation, construction, and validation of electronic subsystems
• Interfacing of ADCs and DACs to analog frontends and a microcontroller
• Integration of subsystems into a complete instrument
• Experimental work, including testing of instruments and data collection in both laboratory and field environments
• Data analysis
• Co-supervision of bachelor and master thesis projects within the project
• Documentation of technical development and research results
• Leading and contributing to scientific publications
You will join a collaborative and interdisciplinary team where you will be working closely with other researchers, technicians, and students at the Department. The project also involves interaction with researchers and end-users working directly with groundwater characterization.

Your profile
Applicants should hold a PhD in electrical engineering or similar. 

Prior experience with surface NMR or groundwater measurements is not required, but we expect you to a have a curiosity for these areas.

We are looking for candidates with experience in several of the following areas:

• Electronic systems design
• Development of low-noise analog and digital electronics including power supplies
• Interfacing to/from ADCs and DACs
• PCB layout
• Solving EMC issues
• Practical electronic and laboratory skills
• Data analysis
Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

• Real-time data acquisition systems implemented on microcontrollers
• Embedded Linux
• Power electronics
• Signal processing and embedded signal processing
It is also advantageous if you have a driver’s license.

Personal skills
You have good English skills, both in speaking and in writing. You take responsibility for assigned tasks and communicate openly about progress, challenges, and ideas. You can work independently as well as in a team. You are open-minded, curious, and have a good sense of humour. We value the ability to work independently as well as in a team.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you believe you are a strong match for the position but do not meet every listed qualification, we would still like to hear from you.

Who we are
The Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at Aarhus University is a leading research institution committed to excellence in research, education, and innovation. The department hosts research spanning electronics, signal processing, embedded systems, sensing technologies, artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, digital twins, power electronics, and many other areas, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and knowledge exchange.

This position will be supervised by Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, whose current research focuses on surface NMR instrumentation, methodology, and applications.

What we offer 
We offer a vibrant and inclusive research environment with a clear commitment to real-world impact. This position provides a rare opportunity to help shape the development of an entirely new scientific instrument, from subsystem design and implementation to system integration, testing, and scientific application. You will have substantial technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and the future research capabilities of the instrument. Denmark is consistently ranked among the best countries in the world for work-life balance and quality of life. Family-friendly policies include generous parental leave, subsidised childcare, and access to excellent public healthcare and education. As a postdoc at Aarhus University, you will benefit from a supportive and flexible workplace culture that values diversity and offers excellent conditions for researchers and their families.

Specifically, we offer:

• A central role in the development of a new surface NMR instrument with unique capabilities for groundwater characterization;
• Opportunities to work across the full development chain, from electronics design and system integration to field deployment and scientific application;
• Access to state-of-the-art laboratory facilities and research infrastructure;
• Strong support for research career development, including mentoring and international networking opportunities;
• A workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment 

The place of work is Finlandsgade 22, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments. 

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, + 45 4189 3273, jjl@ece.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 4 January 2027.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. jobs.occupation: Research Support and Laboratory Infrastructure Specialist - BRIGHT
jobs.description:
DTU BRIGHT is a vibrant and highly driven research environment dedicated to developing biotechnological solutions for a more sustainable future. With state-of-the-art infrastructure and a strong culture of collaboration, BRIGHT brings together motivated researchers working across disciplines to push the boundaries of microbial innovation, sustainable materials, and green food systems. The atmosphere is dynamic, ambitious, and supportive, offering an inspiring and engaging workplace where scientific curiosity and real-world impact go hand in hand. 

The position 
DTU BRIGHT is seeking a highly qualified and motivated specialist to take a leading role in the development, coordination, and continuous improvement of a shared research and laboratory environment supporting three research groups:

• Microbial Foods
• Sustainable Food Innovation
• Fermentation Cultures
The position is established as a specialist function with significant responsibility for ensuring that laboratory infrastructure, biological resources, documentation systems, research workflows, and compliance frameworks effectively support cutting-edge research activities.

You will serve as a key expert within laboratory operations and research support, working closely with researchers, students, technical staff, and group leaders to strengthen research quality, reproducibility, efficiency, and compliance across multiple scientific disciplines.

The role combines scientific expertise, operational leadership, infrastructure development, and project coordination. You are expected to independently identify, develop, and implement solutions that enable high-quality research and support the long-term development of shared research facilities.

Our expectations of you
In this role, you will contribute significantly to the development and support of a shared research environment across three research groups working within sustainable food innovation. You will use your scientific expertise and experience to strengthen the quality, reproducibility, and efficiency of research activities, while helping to ensure that researchers have access to the infrastructure, biological resources, methodologies, and support needed to conduct research at an international level.

The position combines scientific support, infrastructure development, coordination, and laboratory management. You will be expected to work independently and apply sound academic judgement in a broad range of situations, ranging from the development of research workflows and management of biological resources to advising researchers on laboratory practices, documentation standards, and implementation of new methodologies.

A central part of the position will be the continued development and stewardship of shared biological and laboratory resources. This includes responsibility for fungal and bacterial strain collections, laboratory workflows, documentation systems, and procedures that support reproducible and high-quality research. You will contribute to the development of standards and practices that can be applied across multiple research projects and research groups.

The role further includes close interaction with researchers, students, and technical staff throughout the research process. You will contribute to onboarding and training activities, support implementation of new methods and technologies, and facilitate the sharing of knowledge and best practices across laboratories and research groups. Through these activities, you will help strengthen scientific coherence and ensure efficient use of shared facilities and resources.

You will also play an important role in supporting research projects throughout their lifecycle. This may include contributing to project planning, coordinating project-related activities, advising on experimental workflows and data management practices, and helping ensure that laboratory activities are conducted in accordance with relevant quality, compliance, and safety requirements.

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive colleague who enjoys taking responsibility and who is motivated by enabling excellent research. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are able to establish productive working relationships across different academic disciplines and staff groups. At the same time, you are comfortable working independently and driving initiatives forward where improvements, new solutions, or changes are needed.

The successful candidate combines strong scientific insight with excellent coordination skills and a clear commitment to supporting high-quality research. Through your work, you will contribute to the continued development of a well-functioning and scientifically ambitious research environment that supports innovation and collaboration across the participating research groups.

What we offer in return
We offer a dynamic, versatile, and highly enthusiastic research environment at the forefront of food innovation, microbiology, sustainability science, and human health. You will gain unique insight into cutting-edge research taking place across multiple interdisciplinary groups, all working towards solutions for the green transition.

The role provides a central and highly trusted position within the research infrastructure, giving you significant responsibility and ownership over the daily functioning and long-term organization of shared laboratory facilities. You will work closely with researchers at all levels—from students to senior scientists—and become a key link across multiple projects and disciplines.

You will be part of a welcoming, collaborative, and international working environment with strong scientific ambition and a clear focus on real-world impact. The position offers extensive exposure to advanced laboratory workflows, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and best practices in laboratory management, quality control, and scientific data organization.

Beyond day-to-day operations, this role provides an excellent opportunity to develop professionally in areas such as academic research, laboratory coordination, research support strategy, compliance, and scientific infrastructure management, while contributing directly to high-impact research in sustainable food systems.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer or Senior Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position for at least 4 years. Starting date is in January 2027 or according to mutual agreement. 

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Sunday 6 December 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

Further information please contact group leader and senior researcher Leonie Johanna Jahn at lejj@dtu.dk

You can read more about BRIGHT below, and at www.bright.dtu.dk 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

BRIGHT – The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) is a major initiative based at DTU that aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. BRIGHT serves as a hub for academic and industrial partners working together to unlock the potential of bioproduction. BRIGHT focuses on three main areas: Sustainable materials (Developing bio-based alternatives to fossil-derived materials), Microbial foods (Innovating food production through microbial technologies), and Microorganisms for net-zero agriculture (Creating solutions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in agriculture). The goal is to develop and scale innovative biosolutions within these areas, ultimately creating sustainable and competitive alternatives to fossil-based products and processes that can make significant contributions to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.

BRIGHT Mission 2 aims to build an AI-powered framework for the rational design of microbial foods that meet four targets: consumer acceptance, health, sustainability and scalability. The first phase focuses on two fungal chassis, Aspergillus and Yarrowia, characterizing more than 500 prototypes through multi-omics, sensory analysis, life-cycle assessment and safety testing. Predictive models for flavor, texture, nutrition and process scale-up are trained iteratively through active learning. The scientific scope spans strain engineering, adaptive laboratory evolution, solid- and liquid-state fermentation, sensory and consumer research, and pre-clinical and clinical evaluation of safety, bioavailability and cardiometabolic health, in collaboration with national and international partners.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
